newsitem.title: USA: AMEX trades STRYPES on Nextel.
newsitem.headline: AMEX trades STRYPES on Nextel.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Wednesday it had begun trading an equity derivative on class A shares of Nextel Communications Inc.
The so-called Nextel STRYPES Trust is due May 15, 2000. STRYPES stands for structured yield product exchangeable for stock.
Each Nextel STRYPES gives the holder the right to receive an annual distribution, paid out quarterly, of $1.015. The AMEX said Nextel has not paid dividends on its common stock.
The STRYPES will be exchanged for between 0.8403 shares and one class A share of Nextel on the due date.
The actual exchange rate will be calculated on May 15, 2000, and will be based on the price of Nextel class A shares at that time.
The AMEX has set a $16.66 per share "threshold appreciation price" that will also factor in to the exchange rate.
The Nextel STRYPES issue was underwritten by Merrill Lynch and Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
